easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Quicksilver Gargantuan.
description:
Cast Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Quicksilver Gargantuan enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Quicksilver Gargantuan. Choose to have Quicksilver Gargantuan enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.
